func isTransientError(err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return false
	}
	msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	return strings.Contains(msg, "connection refused") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "connection reset") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "connection closed") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "conn closed") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "driver: bad connection") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "unexpected eof") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "connection pool") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "dial tcp") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "i/o timeout") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "eof") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "broken pipe") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 08") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "out of memory") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 53200") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 53300") || // too many clients
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 40p01") || // deadlock detected
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 40001") || // serialization_failure
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 57014") || // statement timeout / canceled
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 57p01") || // admin_shutdown
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 57p02") || // crash_shutdown
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 57p03") || // cannot_connect_now
		strings.Contains(msg, "sqlstate 55p03") || // lock_not_available
		strings.Contains(msg, "deadlock detected")
}

func EnsureDefaultMasterConnection(ctx context.Context, db *gorm.DB, logger *zap.Logger) error {
	err := db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`
		INSERT INTO cdc_system.connection_registry
			(connection_code, display_name, role_type, engine_type, secret_ref, status)
		SELECT 'default_master', 'Default Master Connection',
		       'master', 'postgresql', 'env:CDS_MASTER_DB_PASSWORD', 'active'
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM cdc_system.connection_registry
			WHERE role_type = 'master' AND status = 'active'
		)
		ON CONFLICT (connection_code) DO NOTHING
	`).Error
